These appeals have been filed by the Insurance Company challenging the quantum of compensation awarded by the Tribunal.

2. The case of the appellant is that on 21.12.2014, while the deceased Senthil Kumar was proceeding in his two-wheeler bearing Registration No.TN- 24-F-4747 with the deceased Shanmugam, a bus bearing Registration No.TN- https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis C.M.A.Nos.687 & 689 of 2022 30-AQ-2889 came in a rash and negligent manner and dashed against the two- wheeler of the deceased.
Due to the said accident, the aforesaid Senthil Kumar and Shanmugam died on the spot.

Considering all the aspects, the Tribunal had awarded the compensation in the following manner:
Compensation awarded in CMA.No.687 of 2022:
S.No Particulars Compensation (Rs.) 1 Loss of earnings 14,68,800 2 Transport to hospital 5,000 3 Funeral Expenses 25,000 4 Loss of Consortium 1,50,000 5 Loss of Love and Affection 2,00,000 Total 18,48,000
Compensation awarded in CMA.No.689 of 2022:

S.No Particulars Compensation (Rs.) 1 Loss of earnings 12,24,000 2 Transport to hospital 5,000 3 Funeral Expenses 25,000 4 Loss of Consortium 1,50,000 5 Loss of Love and Affection 2,00,000 Total 16,04,000 3.

At the time of argument, the learned counsel for the appellants in both the appeals would submit that in the present case, the entire amount awarded by https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis C.M.A.Nos.687 & 689 of 2022 the Tribunal has already been deposited and the same has been withdrawn.
Hence, he would request this Court to pass any appropriate order in accordance with law.

sentences.text: 4. Heard the learned counsel for the appellants and also perused the materials available on record.
5. In the present case, considering the facts and circumstances, this Court is of the considered view that the Tribunal had rightly awarded the compensation.
Therefore, since there is no merits in these appeals, this Court is inclined to confirm the award passed by the Tribunal.
6. Accordingly, the compensation awarded by the Tribunal stands confirmed.
In the result, these appeals are dismissed.
No cost.
